_note: Driving sessions (physics/race.js): a test drive in the test worlds, or a race. Each kind: collisions — between cars: full (they hit and take all the damage), reduced (they hit, but take collisions.reduced of the damage from another car; walls as ever) or off (ghosting: they pass through each other); replay — show a slow-motion replay after a big crash (the player's setting, this the default); restore — the development reset (repairs everything, free) is allowed; reset — what going back on the road puts back on: all (every part that came loose or off: a test drive) or wheels (only a wheel torn off, bent and flat, so the car can move: a race; everything else stays as it is); tow — the car can be towed to the garage (it ends the session, and the garage opens on the damage report).

collisions._note: reduced: the share of the damage from another car a car takes; public: the mode public races will use

replay._note: The crash replay (physics/replay.js): the last record s of every car's state kept, rate times a second; a crash at least threshold m/s strong (a big one) plays, after wait s (to see what happened next), the before s up to it and after s after it at speed × real time, from a cinematic angle; skippable straight away, and at most once every cooldown s.
